Definition:
The businesses and
functions engaged in
or supporting revenue
generating activities
that own and manage
risks.
Key responsibilities include::
− Propose the risks required to undertake the revenue generating
activities;
− Identify, monitor, and escalate risks and issues to the Second
Line and senior management and promote a healthy risk culture
and good conduct;
− Manage risks within Risk Appetite and ensure laws and
regulations are being complied with; and
− Ensure systems meet risk data aggregation, risk reporting and
data quality requirements set by the Second Line.
